_comment: Config, not governance. Copy to your private location, edit freely; receipts record manifest_version. Model strings are opaque values.
_comment_constitution_hash_expected: Pins the exact governance bytes; launcher fail-closed on mismatch.
_comment_verifier_id: ADR-019 D4: predicate.verifier.id of the side-car in-toto Statement. A URI under a domain the OPERATOR controls, versioned when the verification logic changes materially (svr.md:86-90); the two values that version it are constitution_hash and manifest_version, both already in the receipt. Replace this placeholder in your own copy. It is a PLACEHOLDER in the *_CLASS_MODEL convention and never a real domain, for ADR-004's reason: no operator literal belongs in a tracked file. scripts/write_statement.py is fail-closed on its absence (STOP: VERIFIER-ID-ABSENT) and never defaults it.
_comment_model_tiers: ADR-005 D4: pack-side bridge from next's opaque model-string to a tier. Resolution: spec.model -> model_tiers[spec.model] -> tiers[T].chain[0]. Fail-closed: a model-string absent here is a STOP, never a default tier. 'top' is reachable only via an explicitly declared model; T0 is never a resolution target.

rules.resolution: first entry in chain; empty chain + resolves_to = single hop DOWNWARD only (T0->T1 legal, T2->T1 never); empty chain without resolves_to = STOP
